title: Uncertainty-Guided Live Measurement Sequencing for Fast SAR ADC Linearity Testing
extraction_scope: Exact preprint identity; PDF Sections III.E–VI and Table I, with page 7 table visually checked. No experimental reproduction.

identity.excluded_followup: 2511.11917 is Advanced Strategies, a distinct enhanced-method paper; its timing improvements are not transferred.

mechanism: Adaptive code-edge selection and local voltage sweeps update a capacitor-mismatch behavioral model using an Extended Kalman Filter; residual-triggered covariance inflation counters overconfidence.

conditions.evaluation: C implementation and simulation experiments; mismatch vectors derived from measured ADC data were resampled and shifted to protect proprietary information (Section IV, page 5).
conditions.statistical_test: 100 synthetic 16-bit ADCs, 200 iterations, 128 samples per sweep and 1.0 LSB RMS noise (Section IV.C, page 6).
conditions.timing_scope: Assumed 1 MS/s acquisition; concurrent acquisition/selection; reusable Jacobian and other matrix setup excluded from per-device totals (Section IV.D, pages 6–7). Compute-platform conditions need verification.
conditions.baseline: Figure 8 compares 12-bit reconstruction against ramp histogram testing at 128 hits per code; cited cross-paper runtime comparisons are not matched local implementations.
conditions.termination: Evaluation uses fixed iterations; uncertainty-based adaptive stopping is discussed as supported, not evaluated as the fixed-budget results.
conditions.failure_modes: Noisy small sweeps can temporarily diverge; later EKF drift from shrinking covariance is acknowledged (Section IV.B, page 6).

limits: Simulation informed by measured devices is not demonstrated live production deployment.
No universal accuracy or fault-detection guarantee; model mismatch and proprietary-data provenance constrain transfer.
Do not import rank-1 update, enhanced polynomial model or 8x result from the distinct follow-up.
next_action: Code the original method and capture its abstract for review; inspect implementation and timing platform before accepting performance claims.
